name: Biological Sciences (BISI) PhD
detailsNote: Official information available. The catalog lists a Fall deadline of December 1, 2026; it does not name Fall 2027 entry, so confirm. The pages do not state GRE policy, minimum English test scores or whether admission is to the program or a lab, so those are left out.
summary: Doctoral program in biological sciences at the University of Maryland, College Park, with four areas of concentration. Students are supported through fellowships and research or teaching assistantships.

deadlines.label: Fall application deadline
deadlines.note: The catalog lists a Fall deadline of December 1, 2026 for both domestic and international applicants. No time is given.

english.note: The catalog lists TOEFL/IELTS/PTE for international graduate students and gives no minimum scores. The Graduate School requires TOEFL, IELTS or PTE scores if you do not hold a degree from a U.S. institution or an exempt country; it will not accept paper IELTS reports.

applicationFee.note: The fee is per program. The Graduate School says fee waivers are limited and considered individually; a FreeApp option for domestic students with financial need ends April 15, 2027. The pages do not say whether international applicants qualify, so confirm.

requirements.note: Optional: up to two writing samples and publications or presentations. Applicants should have a bachelor's degree and coursework in advanced biology and at least one year each of calculus, general chemistry, organic chemistry and physics.

funding.note: Students are supported by fellowships, research assistantships and/or teaching assistantships, each with a stipend, tuition assistance and health and dental insurance. The catalog says: "Historically, all students have been supported throughout their graduate careers." It does not state a guarantee.
